name: Simple Timer MR
summary:
Simple Timer MR fundamentally changes how you manage time by seamlessly integrating powerful timer functionality directly into your real-world environment.
# Key Features 
- **True Mixed Reality (MR) Integration**: Don't just view a timer—place it on any surface in your room: your wall, your desk, your whiteboard. Once placed, it stays there until you move it.
- **Intuitive Hand Tracking**: No controllers needed. Create and position timers with simple, natural gestures.
